profile.headline: Bilingual Full-Stack Software Engineer | React.js | Redux | Node.js | Ruby | Ruby on Rails | PostgreSQL | JavaScript | CSS | HTML5 | Heroku
profile.summary:
NEVER STOP LEARNING, NEVER STOP DREAMING

Bilingual Full Stack Developer with experience using frontend and backend technologies such as Ruby, Rails, Node, JavaScript, and React. Passion to learn new programming and strategies to stay current with the technology. Excited to contribute my lifelong passion for computers and coding to an organization as a software engineer.

My love for computers and programming started when I was in middle school and  I learned Pascal. I was proud that I was able to teach my friends to code and could not wait to learn more! I researched google, watched many youtube videos, and learned how to make my own website. 
In 9th  grade, I created my first website using HTML templates on google.  I did not know anything about code.  I had a lot of fun creating my website and even added music and graphics!  I was cool because I was the only person in my class that could create one.  My passion has never stopped. 

I earned my  Associate of Science in Computer science and wanted to continue.  I just completed my Software Certification from Flatiron School. I have built 4 projects with my cohort, and they are amazing people. I learned a lot of things that I'd never learned before. I'm confident with my knowledge and passionate about learning new things.  

Full-Stack
React.js  
Redux Node.js   
Ruby  
Ruby on Rails   
PostgreSQL 
JavaScript  
CSS  
HTML5  
Heroku

Currently, I own and operate Buddystore.com where I created a commerce website. We sell healthcare and beauty products to the general public. We currently offer over 40 products and are growing.

Website Development
Ecommerce 
Customer Service 
Shopify

Hieu Nguyen
(469)-714-6970
xuanhieu0012@gmail.com

positions.title: Principal | Founder
positions.description:
Using Shopify to create a website for my store, manipulate DOM elements to add features that I want for user experience. Add Shopify payment gateway to help customers checkout on my store. 
Using Shopify admin to manage net income, customers, staff, update products. My store is running for 2 years til now, I have sold products to over 200 customers, most of them come back to buy other products. Around 100 purchase indirectly from Facebook
-An online store that features healthcare products to include, skincare products, vitamins, coconut oils, and beauty items. 
-Created a customized commerce website for customers to purchase items.
-Almost 4000 followers and likes on Facebook fan page.
-Offer over 40 products for sale

positions.title: Software Engineer Certification
positions.description:
Javascript | ReactJS | Ruby | Ruby on Rails | CSS | HTML | JSX

As a full-time student at Flatiron school, 15 weeks intensive boot camp, I have learned many different languages and skills to become a full-stack software engineer.

Skills/Languages

Front-end: Javascripts (ES6+), React.js
Back-end: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, SQL, Postgresql

----------Technical Project-------------

BuddyStoreUS

- A commercial app that allows users to buy many different products such as skincare, healthcare, etc. Users can create an account and save their information. For admin, admin can add new products, edit the quantity of each product or delete the product.
-Built web interface with a React JS frontend, and Ruby on Rails/PostgreSQL backend that allowed users to create an account, save shopping cart, or users can save their information.
-Full CRUD app that enables users to create, view, modify and delete posts.
-Authenticated users at login/signup by encrypting identifying account information using BCrypt.


The Flower Shop

-The commercial app which you can buy flowers or read specific facts details of each flower, many different types of flowers available to purchase. Built all functionality such to add selections to cart, edit basket, update quantity and delete items.
-Developed full CRUD app that enables users to create, view, modify inventory and update  flower selection.
-Created search bar that allows users to search for all flowers by type that are  available in store.


Comosis 
-Social application that allows users to create a  profile, write their status, upload pictures similar to facebook.  
-Created Full CRUD app that enables users to create, view, modify and delete posts.
-Used  React JS frontend to allow users to create profiles, comment on other user's posts.
-Using Ruby on Rails/postgresql backend to create functions to allow users to create username and password.
-Authenticated users at login/signup by encrypting identifying account information using BCrypt.

positions.title: Spa Manager
positions.description:
Managed salon to include preparing work schedules, inventory and supervise employees
Trained all employees to create and manage customer  reservations and requests 
Provided customer service to guests by helping with requests and de-escalate customer issues.
